children: NeoGenomics appointed Chief Operating Officer Warren Stone as its next chief executive, effective Jan. 4.
Stone will succeed the current CEO, Tony Zook, who will assume a role of executive chair. Stone will also join the board.

"I have witnessed firsthand Warren's ability to lead enterprise-wide functions and projects, which have advanced many of our key priorities, such as commercial expansion and customer impact, new product introductions, and our Lab of the Future initiatives," Zook said. "With our aligned long-term strategy in place and delivering results, this transition emphasizes strategic continuity."

The oncology diagnostic solutions company said that board Chair Lynn Tetrault will step down Jan. 4, and leave the board fully after the company's 2027 stockholder meeting. NeoGenomics appointed board member Michael Kelly as its incoming lead independent director.

The company also said Monday that it expects to report third-quarter revenue of about $209 million, with next-generating sequencing revenue growth of about 28%. Analysts polled by FactSet were expecting third-quarter revenue of $205.9 million.

Based on the third-quarter performance, NeoGenomics said it expects to raise its full-year revenue and adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization guidance on its third-quarter earnings call.
Shares fell 2.3% to $18.68 in after-hours trading on Monday.
